string-array.name: consent_accessibility_body
string-array.item: Ronumi uses Android accessibility access to see which app is open and read relevant text and controls on its screen.
This can include website addresses, video titles, and channel names. Ronumi uses this data to apply the blocking rules you choose.
While access is on, blocking can work when Ronumi is not open. Screen data stays on your device. We do not receive it.

Ronumi can cover blocked content, pause playback, and use buttons or navigation to leave it. It can close a blocked picture-in-picture video window. Returning from a website block replaces that page with a blank page in the same tab.
Ronumi is a focus app. It is not an accessibility tool for people with disabilities.
You can turn this access off in Android Settings. You can use the timer without it.

string-array.name: consent_usage_body
string-array.item: Ronumi reads which apps you use, how long you use them, and phone unlock events. It saves daily totals for screen-time reports and app limits.
It checks usage while your rules run, including when Ronumi is not open. This data stays on your device.
You can turn usage access off in Android Settings. The timer works without it. Usage reports and daily app limits need this access.

string-array.name: consent_notification_body
string-array.item: Android gives Ronumi access to notifications. Ronumi saves the title, text, app, and time from the apps you select. It uses a notification identifier to update saved messages.
After saving a selected notification, Ronumi removes it from the notification drawer. You can read it later in the inbox.
Holding works during focus and schedules, or all the time if you choose that setting. It works when Ronumi is not open.
Messages stay on your device until you clear the inbox or remove app data. We do not receive them.
You can decline access or turn it off in Android Settings. The timer and app blocking still work.
Granting access does not import notifications that arrived before you agreed.

string-array.name: consent_app_list_body
string-array.item: Ronumi reads app names and icons to let you choose your blocks. It identifies browsers and home-screen apps to apply your rules.
This list stays on your device.
